files.html:
0.2.0 Change Log

Changed

  • Improved editor control sizing, text clipping, and layout across Quest, Faction, GUI, and HUD editors.
  • Unified hover help with localized, adaptive DRM-styled tooltips.
  • Improved Gecko animation preview and multiplayer synchronization.

Added

  • Added Tooltip Maker with custom layouts, item models, images, text, scrolling, resizing, and entrance animations.
  • Added player-head HUD rendering and dialogue choice text size and pulse effects.
  • Added Gecko animation routes with Goto target support.

Fixed

  • Fixed dialogue navigation stopping later actions such as animations and commands.
  • Fixed late Gecko animation playback, preview seeking, retry handling, and fallback rendering.
  • Fixed overlapping, stretched, or incorrectly clipped controls in multiple editors.
